ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M1 Pro, Unspecified Version)

scope: Existing saved 1000-part three-storey house, real fire/smoke/damage/support/collapse enabled. First three ignition seeds, then deliberate ignition of every combustible part. Not a new creative socket build or a manual placement trial.
workers: 1–4 support workers with persistent mirrors, dependency proofs and <=128 targets per job. Existing <=2 geometry workers. Fire/smoke scheduling is cooperative MAIN THREAD work, not another worker.
environment: M1 Pro / headless Chrome / 1440x900 / Vite / approximately 60 Hz. Live weather and different camera paths per phase. Not RTX, not a frozen-world causal A/B, not a 120 Hz validation.
policy: Native assets remain production default. Primitive variant is only a diagnostic adapter. Animals, part surface snow, thermal fields OFF; weather, ground/tree snow, fire, smoke, support and collapse ON.
time: Windows are wall-clock durations. Simulation can lag behind wall time under overload; the phase name alone is NOT evidence a collapse occurred. Standing/ruin counts and simulation elapsed time are reported. Startup, restore and screenshots excluded.
finalGuard: After this recording, the worker client was additionally fixed to drain already-queued useful replies before its churn fallback. Covered by regression tests; these frame times are NOT a remeasurement after that final guard.
